jess: Ok team — need to lock the acceptance criteria for the Acme trial. They want 3 prioritized flows (inbound routing, invoice extraction, short answer bot), clear scoring, and a timeline for delivery. Also they pushed legal/security Qs today. Can we align?
marcus: Quick sketch: propose a success matrix with measurable gates + a small seed dataset (30 gold examples per flow) for initial regression checks.
sanjay: +1. Also need to confirm whether they want dedicated capacity for throughput. Pricing will differ if they require reserved GPUs.
lisa: Security blockers flagged: SSO (SAML), EU data residency, and KMS integration for keys. They also asked for evidence of SOC2 for our private deployment.
nana: (typo) ana: I can own the infra checklist: SSO test plan, KMS handshake test, traffic egress map. ETA: EOD Thu for a first pass.
jess: Thanks — marcus can you draft the scoring rubric? Keep it simple: pass/fail for infra + a numeric quality score for each flow. Also include latency and cost thresholds.
marcus: Draft below — please comment.
marcus: ```
Success matrix (proposal):
- Infra gates (PASS/FAIL): SSO integration, KMS key rotation test, EU region deployment verified
- Reliability: Uptime >= 99.5% during trial window (30 days)
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms for short-answer flows; p95 <= 800ms for long extraction on dedicated nodes
- Quality: golden-seed average F1 or normalized score >= 0.80 per flow
- Regression gate: no more than 5% drop vs baseline on golden-seed after any model change
- Cost: average inference cost per 1k tokens below agreed trial cap (we'll set initial cap)
```
marcus: Example golden-seed item format: ```json
{"id":"seed-001","flow":"invoice-extract","prompt":"Extract invoice total and currency","gold":"{\"total\":12349.00,\"currency\":\"USD\"}","weight":"2"}
```
sanjay: For pricing: recommend we offer a 30-day trial at 50% listed hosted rate or a fixed trial credit tied to usage. If they ask for dedicated, quote a 1-month reserved node at 40% list with overage. Need to sync with finance.
jess: Good. Add acceptance criteria for human eval: 3 annotators, majority label for pass/fail, label rubric attached.
marcus: Human eval rubric (short form): 
- Exactness: extraction fields match values (weight 0.6)
- Completeness: all required fields present (weight 0.3)
- Format: output adheres to JSON schema (weight 0.1)

Pass threshold: weighted avg >= 0.8

lisa: On legal side: they asked for a data processing agreement and a list of subprocessors. Also want a timeline for security questionnaire answers — can we commit 5 business days?
jess: We can commit to 5 biz days if security has time. lisa, can you own the questionnaire responses?
lisa: I can. Will need a table of any data flows that touch vendor systems. Send me the seedset examples and infra diagram.
nana: ana: I'll upload the infra diagram to the shared drive and stub the traffic flow doc.
sanjay: One enterprise blocker: Acme's compliance team requires that any PII extracted is never written to logs. Need a confirmation we can mask or omit PII from logs in the trial environment.
nana: ana: We can enable a no-log mode for the trial cluster and configure KV cache retention to 0. Need dev signoff to ensure no telemetry leaks.
marcus: I'll add a simple `no_log=true` config flag to the trial deployment and a test that asserts logs contain no PII tokens.
jess: Timeline draft: 
- Today: agree on matrix and responsibilities
- +2 business days: seedset (30x per flow) uploaded + initial infra diagram
- +5 business days: security questionnaire answers + basic SSO/KMS test plan
- +10 business days: trial deployment and smoke tests complete
- +30 days: evaluation window ends, final report + decision

sanjay: That timeline seems fine for commercial team. Finance: can we get an approval on the trial credit by EOD tomorrow?
jess: I'll ping finance. @lisa will post the security timeline once she reviews the seedset.
lisa: Will review — expect the questionnaire draft by Tue morning.
marcus: Quick note on scoring: we should record per-example scores so we can show customers where regressions happen. Also add a manual override flag for borderline examples to capture edge-case context.
jess: Perfect. Action items: marcus -> produce seedset template + scoring sheet; ana -> infra diagram + note on no-log mode; lisa -> security Q responses; sanjay -> pricing options and draft quote; jess -> coordinate finance/AE handoff.
